notes.title: Storm Tale 2 is Here!
notes.content:
We’re pleased to announce the premier Steam release of [b]Storm Tale 2[/b]. 

Sharpen your sword and take up your bow - it’s time to fight back a powerful sorcerer and his mighty dragon. Join Griffri, the wizard, on a quest to not only rebuild his village, but to put an end to the perilous reign of evil that threatens the realm. Play bonus mini-games with cool 3D hidden object scenes and jigsaw puzzles. Beat the obstacles and win many trophies on your journey through this addictive match 3 game. Bring the peace back to this fabulous land. Are you ready for an adventure?

[previewyoutube=kceH-IDe7Pg;full][/previewyoutube]

Check it out! https://store.steampowered.com/app/1588940/Storm_Tale_2/

notes.title: Lost Progress Bug is now Completely Fixed!
notes.content:
Hi Tales of the Orient - The Rising Sun Fans!

After some deep investigation, we found the bug which was causing Lost of the Game Progress after some time! And now it is completely fixed!

Anybody which lost the progress and want an updated save file please drop an email to contact@greensaucegames.com with more info and we will provide an updated save file.
The bug now is fully fixed and should not happen anymore!

Thanks for the Support!

notes.title: Brazilian Portuguese, Polish and Czech languages are now supported!
notes.content:
There is a new update to Tales of the Orient - The Rising Sun! 

- Added support for Brazilian Portuguese, Polish and Czech languages.
- Bug Fixes and Improvements 
- Added an Extra button on Main Menu, now you can Visit Us on Facebook! =)

The game now supports 7 languages (English, French, German, Brazilian Portuguese, Polish, Czech and Russian). You can change the game language on Options Screen.
